Snake River Jump

One scooter, one spring launcher and a canyon you will not clear on the first try. Land it on your wheels on the far side to finish. Every jump pays by the foot. Flips pay extra, but only if he ends the jump the right way up. Sponsors pay for stunts, and the money buys a better scooter.
